sections.skill: Describe a function qualitatively from a situation

questions.skill: Describe a function qualitatively from a situation
questions.prompt: A car speeds up, drives at a constant speed, then slows to a stop. Describe the graph of its speed over time.
questions.prompt_markup:
A car speeds up, drives at a constant speed, then slows to a stop.
Describe the graph of its speed over time.
questions.correct_answer: It rises, then stays level, then falls to 0.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent description of the three parts.

questions.skill: Describe a function qualitatively from a situation
questions.prompt: A graph of water level is horizontal from t = 2 to t = 5. What does that mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
A graph of water level is horizontal from t = 2 to t = 5.
What does that mean?
questions.correct_answer: The water level did not change from t = 2 to t = 5.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent wording.

questions.skill: Describe a function qualitatively from a situation
questions.prompt: Which situation has a graph that first increases and then decreases?
questions.prompt_markup: Which situation has a graph that first increases and then decreases?

choices.text: Savings with a steady deposit each week
The height of a ball thrown up that comes back down
The distance a parked car travels
The height of a burning candle

questions.correct_answer: The height of a ball thrown up that comes back down
questions.grading_note: The ball rises and then falls. A burning candle only gets shorter, a parked car's distance stays the same, and steady deposits only increase.

questions.skill: Describe a function qualitatively from a situation
questions.prompt: On a distance-time graph, a steeper segment means a greater speed.
questions.prompt_markup: On a distance-time graph, a steeper segment means a greater speed.
questions.grading_note: More distance in the same time.

questions.skill: Describe a function qualitatively from a situation
questions.prompt: A decreasing graph always means the quantity is negative.
questions.prompt_markup: A decreasing graph always means the quantity is negative.
questions.grading_note: A quantity can decrease while staying positive.
